title: "Post a contact form"

---

```http
POST /v1/forms/{id}
```

Posted from a website, by an HTML form (no JavaScript needed), JSON or multipart (up to 3 files of PDF, PNG, JPEG or plain text, 2 MiB in all). Create the form in the dashboard first; it is off unless the operator set `FORMS_ENABLED`. - The field `email` is required (replies go there); other fields are free text (letters, digits, `_ . -` in names; up to 30 fields, 5000 characters each). - A browser's `Origin` (or `Referer`) must be one of the form's allowed origins, or the post is `403 origin_not_allowed`. CORS answers are given only to those origins. - Keep the field `hp_website` empty and hidden: a filled one is answered as success and kept nowhere. - If the form requires it, fetch a single-use `_nonce` first (`GET /v1/forms/{id}/nonce`) and post it back. - Limits per address, per form, per sender and per workspace answer `429` with `Retry-After`. - The message is scored for spam (allow, flag, quarantine, reject) and checked against the workspace's filters; rejected posts are `422 spam_rejected` and not kept. JSON clients get JSON; HTML form posts get a thank-you page or a `303` to the form's thank-you address.

## Authentication

None. This endpoint is public: it is called by browsers or mail clients, never with your API key.

## Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | &nbsp; |

## Request body

Content type: `application/json`. Required.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `email` | string | yes | &nbsp; |
| `name` | string | no | &nbsp; |
| `message` | string | no | &nbsp; |

Example:

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.org"
}
```

## Responses

### 202

Received

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (uuid) | no | &nbsp; |
| `status` | "received" | no | &nbsp; |

```json
{
  "id": "6f1c2d0e-3b52-4d49-9a43-7d1f0c5e8a11",
  "status": "received"
}
```

### 303

HTML form post with a thank-you address set

### 403

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "origin_not_allowed"
  }
}
```

### 404

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "forms_disabled"
  }
}
```

### 422

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "invalid_email"
  }
}
```

### 429

Error. See `error.code`.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limited"
  }
}
```

## Error codes

Errors share one shape: `error.code` is stable, `error.message` is optional detail. Retry only timeouts, network errors, `429` and `5xx`, with the same idempotency key; fix the request for every other `4xx`.

| Code | HTTP | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `forms_disabled` | 404 | Forms: the operator has not turned forms on |
| `not_found` | 404 | Unknown id, or one that belongs to another project or environment |
| `origin_not_allowed` | 403 | Forms: the page's origin is not one of the form's allowed origins |
| `rate_limited` | 429 | A limit was reached. See `Retry-After` |
| `invalid_email` | 422 | Contacts: the address is not valid |
| `invalid_field` | 422 | Forms: a field name or value is not accepted (names are letters, digits, `_ . -`) |
| `field_too_long` | 422 | Forms: a field is longer than 5000 characters |
| `form_too_large` | 422 | Forms: the fields add up to more than 20,000 characters |
| `too_many_fields` | 422 | Forms: more than 30 fields |
| `too_many_files` | 422 | Forms: more than 3 files |
| `file_type_not_allowed` | 422 | Forms: a file is not PDF, PNG, JPEG or plain text |
| `files_too_large` | 422 | Forms: files add up to more than 2 MiB |
| `nonce_required` | 422 | Forms: the form needs a nonce from `GET /v1/forms/{id}/nonce` |
| `nonce_invalid` | 422 | Forms: the nonce is unknown, used already or older than an hour |
| `spam_rejected` | 422 | Forms: the message looks like spam and was not kept |
| `body_too_large` | 413 | Request body over the size limit |
| `invalid_request` | 422 | Unreadable JSON, unknown field, or a missing required field |
| `service_unavailable` | 503 | Storage was unavailable. Nothing was accepted |

Every code is explained on [Rate limits and errors](/docs/api/rate-limits-and-errors).
